title: The Core Verbs
label: ch:ka-core-verbs
canDo: I can build a Kannada verb as stem plus tense plus person, swap the middle bead for the past, hear the p → h law that separates Kannada from its three sisters, and say why ಗೊತ್ತು carries no person at all.

payoff.summary: Say ನನಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತು, name the three slots that built iruttēne, hōguttēne and nōḍuttēne, explain which slot ಗೊತ್ತು leaves empty and where its person went instead, and give the sound-law behind pōgu → hōgu.
